newsitem.title: CANADA: CIBC to get Q2 C$50 million gain.
newsitem.headline: CIBC to get Q2 C$50 million gain.

text.p: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce said on Monday it will realize a C$50 million second quarter gain on the sale and write-down of some real estate properties.

Canada's second biggest bank said in a statement that it had signed a letter of intent with a wholly owned subsidiary of Edper Group Ltd to sell 100 percent of its interest in a portion of the land under BCE Place in Toronto.
Edper said in a separate statement that its subsidiary will issue a C$104 million six percent preferred share issue to pay for the real estate deal.

Canadian Imperial said it will realize an after tax gain of approximately C$62 million from this sale, but at the same time the bank said it will take a write down of other properties totalling approximately C$12 million after tax.

Edper said its preferred shares will be retractable in 10 years and can be redeemed by Edper for cash or class A treasury shares of Edper based on the market price at the time or by Edper delivering eight million common shares of Brookfield Properties Corp. Canadian Imperial has the right to convert its preferred shares into eight million common shares of Brookfield, which is 68 percent owned by Edper.
